name: opt-in-signal-keys-click-ids
description: signalKeys.clickIds limited to six click IDs: ?twclid=T1 is neither a signal nor stored, so the landing has no signal.
quirk_decision: CONTRACT (opt-in, #71): default reads every key in CLICK_ID_KEYS and UTM_PARAM_TO_FIELD. Semver: additive opt-in parse option (minor); defaults, CLASSIFIER_VERSION and SCHEMA_VERSION unchanged.
